# Material Icons (Google), used for the icons in Figure 2

`MaterialIcons-Regular.ttf` and its `.codepoints` map, from
github.com/google/material-design-icons, `font/` on `master`, fetched
2026-11-02. Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`, beside this file).

`scripts/gen_taxonomy_figure.py` draws one glyph per channel and consequence
from this font; the PDF embeds the subset it uses.
